3.4.2. Phase 2 — Post-Scoring Allowlist Suppression
The second phase introduced the allowlist, which removes known-benign flows
after scoring. The effect was transformational. Corpus-wide Hit@10 rose from two of
five families to all five, and every family’s first-true-positive rank collapsed toward the
top of the ranking: TheWiSpy improved from rank 30 to rank 1, and both families that
had been complete misses in Phase 1 — FlexiSPY and mSpy —
